# better-auth-mongoose

> A Mongoose-native database adapter for Better Auth, plus an optional tenant-scoping plugin.
> Community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Better Auth team.

Better Auth's official MongoDB adapter talks to the raw `mongodb` driver, not Mongoose.
better-auth-mongoose registers Better Auth's `user`, `session`, `account`, and other tables
as real, extensible Mongoose models on a connection you already own, so `.populate()`, schema
validation, and hooks work the same way they do for the rest of your app. It has zero direct
dependencies and never pulls in the raw `mongodb` driver.

## Packages

- better-auth-mongoose (npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/better-auth-mongoose) — the adapter.
  Install: `pnpm add better-auth-mongoose mongoose better-auth`
  README: https://github.com/AshwinSathian/better-auth-mongoose/tree/main/packages/better-auth-mongoose#readme
- better-auth-mongoose-tenant (npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/better-auth-mongoose-tenant) —
  optional tenant-scoped query middleware for Better Auth's organization plugin. Install:
  `pnpm add better-auth-mongoose-tenant`
  README: https://github.com/AshwinSathian/better-auth-mongoose/tree/main/packages/better-auth-mongoose-tenant#readme

## Minimal usage

```ts
import { betterAuth } from "better-auth";
import { mongooseAdapter } from "better-auth-mongoose";
import mongoose from "mongoose";

await mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGO_URI!);

export const auth = betterAuth({
  database: mongooseAdapter(mongoose.connection),
});
```

## Facts

- License: MIT.
- Source: https://github.com/AshwinSathian/better-auth-mongoose
- Supported Mongoose versions: 6, 7, 8, 9 (peer range).
- Supported Better Auth versions: 1.4, 1.5, 1.6 (peer range), verified in CI on every push.
- Proof: packages/better-auth-mongoose/test/populate.test.ts is a real, CI-run test
  demonstrating .populate() against a Better-Auth-created document. The adapter also
  passes the official @better-auth/test-utils adapter contract suite.
- Example app: examples/nestjs-mongoose, a full NestJS app exercised in CI over real HTTP.
